The financial advisor (FA) is bound to a certain insurance/bank/company and only allowed to sell that certain companys financial products. So the only way to be a good IFA and really sell products that he customer really benefits from, the IFAs have to start a "group". A very lose combination of IFAs that all work on their own or even compete with each other but pay a part of their income to that group so the paperwork and regulations are done correctly. One man could never ever do that alone. Paperwork is more then actuall consulting these days.  I know this because I am an IFA.  Just let these numbers sink in: - over 200.000 FAs in Germany - not even 50.000 IFAs, most of them die out - not even 10.000 IFAs organized in "groups"  Now you can imagine how f*** up this is for the old folks who doesnt understand the difference and still believe the oldschool way that the bank wants you and them to benefit.
